prompt_refinement.style_rules: Match the palette, brush feel, lighting, icon density, and framing discipline of the selected target's reference image. Keep the final subject and asset meaning driven by the selected batch entry, not the reference subject.
prompt_refinement.composition_rules: Use the reference only as a style guide. Keep the result in the same visual family, but make it visibly distinct at a glance by changing the silhouette, crop, object arrangement, and ornament placement. Do not mirror the reference composition or reuse its exact outline.

image.natural_prompt: Minimalist victory iconography with marble, bronze, and path-specific theme-color accents.

style_reference.notes: Each output target must provide one or more same-type DDS/PNG references. The reference controls style only; the generated content follows image.natural_prompt.

building_icon.prompt_requirements: This is a compact building icon for the Wonder Worksite. Treat the uploaded Construction Center reference as the style authority: same simple painterly brushwork, compact crop, low object count, and readable 128px silhouette. Depict a wonder construction worksite using exactly 2-3 simple shapes: one small worksite shed, one crane or hoist wheel, and one pale stone foundation block. The result should feel premium through restrained marble and bronze accents while staying as simple as the reference. Do not add extra props, workers, crowds, complex scaffolding, full scenery, a finished monument, a palace, or a narrative construction scene.

image.natural_prompt: A simple Europa Universalis V building icon in the uploaded vanilla Construction Center style. Match the reference's painterly icon language, compact crop, simple silhouette, and low element count. Show a wonder construction worksite with only three clear elements: a small worksite shed, one crane or hoist wheel, and one pale stone foundation block with restrained bronze accents. Sparse, centered, readable at 128px, premium but not ornate, no text.
image.negative_prompt: busy construction scene, many objects, extra props, many tools, crowds, workers, multiple buildings, complex scaffolding, ornate palace, completed monument, giant statue, landscape background, detailed narrative scene, realistic photo, text, letters, logo, UI frame

victory_tree_backgrounds.tree_rules: A beautiful, high-quality 16:9 painting or photograph of a single tree standing close to the viewer, large enough to dominate the frame and partly block a hazy, distant landscape beyond it — near and far are the same place under the same light, not a collage. Let the tree feel bigger than the picture: at the edge named below, a branch or the trunk simply runs off the frame, as though only part of a larger tree was caught in view, so no roots or ground appear there. Let the trunk fork naturally into a handful of branches as it grows, each with some open, unembellished stretches of bark — a round button will be overlaid on the branches later, so avoid drawing circles, rings, or icons, but otherwise trust your own eye for where and how the branches should fall. Prioritize a gorgeous, atmospheric, painterly result over any rigid structure. No text or UI elements.
victory_tree_backgrounds.negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, labels, UI buttons, circular nodes or rings, badges, medallions, icons on the tree, logos, watermark, flat 2D illustration, cutout foreground pasted over a backdrop, mismatched lighting between tree and background, visible roots or ground line at the cropped edge, whole tree fully contained in frame, second tree

paths.label: Conquest Victory
paths.tree_prompt: A medieval mood in crimson and iron: a stark, weathered ironwood tree against a dusty frontier of far-off fortress walls. It enters cropped at the lower-left edge and climbs diagonally toward the upper-right, branching outward in a disciplined, angular way as it ascends. Forceful, territorial, irreversible.

paths.label: Prosperity Victory
paths.tree_prompt: An Art Nouveau mood in leaf green and warm gold: a graceful cultivated tree rising from a hazy valley of orchards and terraces. It enters cropped at the bottom-center edge and climbs vertically toward the top-center, its slender stems branching generously and rhythmically to either side. Abundant, flourishing, alive.

paths.label: Trade Victory
paths.tree_prompt: A maritime trade mood in gold and ink-navy: a wind-bent tree with a strongly horizontal trunk, set against a hazy harbor of distant sails and warehouses. It enters cropped at the left-center edge and reaches across toward the right-center, branching above and below the trunk like shipping lanes. Expansive, adventurous, far-reaching.

paths.label: Diplomatic Victory
paths.tree_prompt: A restrained Baroque mood in ivory and antique gold: an elegant tree with finely spaced branches, set against a hazy palace garden. It enters cropped at the upper-left edge and descends diagonally toward the lower-right, its branches arcing outward in balanced pairs. Composed, negotiated, dignified rather than forceful.

paths.label: Cultural Victory
paths.tree_prompt: A Chinese ink-wash mood on rice paper, charcoal black with soft purple accents, set against a misty wash of distant academy roofs. One commanding tree rendered in confident dry-brush strokes. It enters cropped at the lower-right edge and rises diagonally toward the upper-left, its brush branches flowing outward with generous blank-paper space. Contemplative, refined. No Chinese characters.

paths.label: Scientific Victory
paths.tree_prompt: A clean, modern mood in azure and cool white: an innovation tree with a luminous geometric spine, set against a hazy field of observatory machinery. It enters cropped at the top-center edge and descends vertically toward the bottom-center, branching alternately left and right like careful circuitry. Precise, exploratory, forward-looking.
